notes.title: The Big Reveal Is Finally Here ...
notes.content:
Hiya Everybody! 👋

I’d like to welcome you all to Norigin – [b]a cinematic boss climbing game[/b]🧗 that comfortably sits within the confines of the boss rush subgenre.

In case you missed it, the Norigin reveal trailer was officially shown by IGN below a few weeks ago🎥 (all a bit surreal that this little indie game has started to get legs)

[previewyoutube=ZYapOXLgMnw;full][/previewyoutube]

Although the Steam page has been up for a while, the online presence of Norigin has been pretty much dormant up until this month.

[b]Why? [/b]

Well, pretty much from its inception (minus a few months) I have been wrestling with trying to get the core mechanics, art style and narrative aligned (all while raising a family etc - the usual😅). Now that things are more in unison, [b]I feel it is a good time to go on this dev journey more publicly[/b].

The good thing [b]there is now a playable prototype actively in development that reflects the core boss climbing loop[/b] (with snippets of this gameplay shown in the trailer). However there are still [b]LOTS of key features that need to be added[/b] and developed at various stages before the game is ready to ship such as mini-bosses and puzzles just to name a few.

I am looking to give you all high level dev updates here on Steam - so make sure to give a follow if you’re curious!

[b]For all questions like whether there will be a public demo etc please refer to the FAQ[/b] (Frequently Asked Questions) page 🙋🙋‍♂️ – and feel free to make suggestions in case I missed anything too! 

Oh … and who am I? Well I'm the director behind Norigin. Currently I work solo with contractors that rotate on and off the project depending on its needs in a sort of ramp on/ramp off basis. 

And of course - make sure you [b][u]add Norigin to your wishlist if you’re interested in the game![/u][/b] (it helps show how much interest the game has and helps give visibility to it).

Thanks for coming along on this journey with me! 🏃
[i]Jugraaj (Indie Dev) | JSS Games[/i]

P.S. [url=https://discord.gg/UgyE6MzTCc]Join the discord by clicking here[/url] and become a part of the Norigin community - we'd love to have you! ☺️
